note: DECISION register: every open owner decision and owner issue that could gate the implementation plan, with its options, the current-fact evidence for and against each, the consequence of each option on the sequence, and the evidence-backed default the plan ASSUMES until the owner decides.  status: DECIDED (decided by an earlier delta or the owner) | ASSUMED-DEFAULT (the plan runs under the default; the owner flips it by editing this row through S-FIXTURE, which re-selects the gated deltas) | OWNER-ONLY (no defensible default; the gated deltas wait) | NOT-GATING (no sequence step depends on it).  The agent decides nothing here.

rows.title: home origin of the installed Factory
rows.question: on which origin does the Factory seed live?

options.option: a dedicated HTTPS origin whose storage no other page shares; loopback (a secure context) as the evidence origin of every delta run in this environment

consequence.FC-1: seed failure matrix on loopback; the public origin run is external
consequence.FC-8: the closure experiment on loopback; the public-origin run recorded as external evidence

options.option: a loopback server as the permanent home

consequence.FC-8: no public origin ever exercised: acceptance steps 1 and 10 stay bound to a host process

options.option: a shared host (raw.githack.com, <user>.github.io)

consequence.FC-1: every page of the shared host reaches the Factory storage: confinement breaks

default.reason: storage is origin-scoped and same-origin code reaches all of it (P03 + P08): only a dedicated origin keeps the seed and its pointers out of other pages' reach; loopback serves every proof this environment can run

rows.external_input: the host name and hosting of the dedicated HTTPS origin, and one run of tests/physical/PUBLIC-HTTPS-PROBE.md there

consequence.FC-8: the closure experiment executes a generated app on its own origin

consequence.FC-8: the executed app can reach Factory storage

options.option: B4 first-party Rust-subset compiler before anything else

rows.title: BUILD with no contract registry

options.option: refuse: BUILD without a registry reports NO_LEGAL_PLAN / NO_PLAN and emits no artifact beyond CAPABILITY_IR

rows.title: seed replacement after installation
rows.question: may the seed be replaced after install, and by whom?

options.option: only as an origin event approved by the owner: the new seed is qualified by the failure matrix before it is served; the platform makes the swap atomic

consequence.FC-1: the failure matrix includes a seed replacement case (v1 -> v2 qualified; interrupted replacement keeps v1)
consequence.FC-8: no seed replacement inside the closure experiment

options.option: never after installation

consequence.FC-1: a seed defect found later is unrepairable except by site-data clearing

options.option: any time by whoever serves the origin

consequence.FC-1: a served defect is fatal offline for every installation
consequence.FC-8: the TCB grows to the origin server at all times

default.reason: a service worker cannot replace itself from local bytes and a broken one is fatal offline; replacement is possible only from the origin and must be qualified before it is served
